notes.title: Deeper Underground update
notes.notes:
Dear Oil entrepreneurs,

Today's update brings some bug fixes and updated mechanics! Many thanks to everyone who reported bugs on the Turmoil Steam Community boards. Please know that even if we do not respond to every post, we do read them and your feedback is much appreciated!

Features
[list]
[*] We changed the reward for picking up a ruby in deep mode. Instead of getting a bonus at the end of the level, you now directly get a bonus of $500 for your research fund.
[*] Added some visual feedback for passing every 100m in Deepmode.
[/list]
Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Updated localization files
[*] Fixed an issue where Deepmode levels sometimes had the background of the cliffs levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where the extra time you get for using a diamond in the main game is not counted in your final profit of the level.
[*] Fixed an issue with the water valve audio in deepmode and dynamite countdown audio not being affected by volume sliders.
[/list]

notes.title: 3.0.70 - Save backups and lots of bug fixes
notes.notes:
Dear oil entrepreneurs,

Today's update brings some long needed bug fixes and tweaks. Many thanks to everyone who reported bugs on the Turmoil Steam Community boards. Please know that even if we do not respond to every post, we do read them and your feedback is much appreciated!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Campaigns, single levels, challenge levels and player progress are now backed up before saving a new one. The backup is loaded in case the original is corrupted or no longer exists.
[*]Added Steam Rich Presence which displays your ingame status in the Steam friends list while you are playing. The status indicates when you are playing a campaign and in what year, whether you are in a level, and so on.
[*]You can now view your bought saloon offers instead of them disappearing from the list. This means you can now review the saloon offers that will be active for the next level.
[/list]

[h2]Big bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The bonus island in the Turmoil and Heat Is On campaigns no longer always has the same layout.
[*]The bonus island in The Heat Is On now actually contains magma.
[*]Fixed issue where you could not resume level progress for bonus islands.
[*]Playing the bonus island after the end of the game in The Heat Is On no longer crashes the end of the level.
[*]In level: Fixed an issue where you could sometimes not close dialog boxes when the spillage message was displayed behind them. This includes upgrade introduction messages and the Left/Right inc. deal popup.
[*]Fixed an issue where a corrupted level in progress would make it impossible to load an existing campaign.
[*]The “you have not played the tutorial” popup when starting a challenge level is now shown only once instead of every time.
[/list]

[h2]Small changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Exit game button now shows a single confirmation popup instead of two in a row
[*]Highscore menu: always show "Top scores" as default tab (since its cached)
[*]Elbow now shows different localization tag for toggle tooltip when ctrl+click is enabled.
[*]The silo tutorial now displays a message when you cant place a silo instead of softlocking.
[*]The super silo upgrade button hover text is now properly localized.
[*]Costs are refunded after being forced to buy a mole or scanner in the tutorial.
[*]Made the saloon offer price red and ok button disabled when you dont have enough money
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous changes and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated localization files.
[*]You can now close the text in the land auction by clicking on the map.
[*]Time in the cloud conflict popup is now displayed in the correct local timezone.
[*]Time and date in the challenge highscore menu is now display in the correct local timezone.
[*]Town: fixed an issue where the factory tutorial could block all input while the bankruptcy popup was displayed at the same time.
[*]Town: can now click the player/rival upgrade scroll to close it, instead of only the arrow button.
[*]Fixed several issues causing the loading screen to get stuck when an error occurs.
[*]The loading icon for online communication has been changed from the Gamious logo to a set of rig wheels.
[*]Fixed a display issue with the candle in the Underground.
[*]The supersilo upgrade price tooltip color now updates from red to white after gaining enough money to buy it.
[*]Fixed issue in the Underground building where the shutter would not open to the correct height after the game is finished.
[*]Completion of the tutorial is now properly stored in the player’s progress savefile.
[*]Fixed bug: if you open the town hall after the game has ended in The Heat Is On, you can no longer click on the other buildings.
[*]Fixed an issue where playing Higher Lower after the bonus island does not reset the Higher Lower game.
[/list]

[*]The campaign AI will now purchase upgrades in a logical order again, which may slightly impact difficulty. Shout-out to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FsYZk1Eagt0]Stuff+[/url] for pointing this out. Yes, the AI does need to purchase upgrades in order to improve their profits.

notes.title: Patch notes for v3.0.38
notes.notes:
Dear oil entrepreneurs,

Version 3.0.38 of Turmoil is now available. This patch brings some minor bugfixes and several changes to tune the game balance.

[h3]Game speed has been lowered by 10%[/h3]
After the 3.0 update, we found the game was running 20% faster than the old version. This put a little bit too much pressure on decision making, so we decided to lower it by 10% again. This means the result is still a little more fast paced than before, but not as frantic.

[h3]Mole changes[/h3]
The mole gas-seeking behaviour now uses the distance to the nearest corner of the gas well, instead of the distance to the center of the gas well when determining whether to reveal it. It improves the reliability of finding gas bubbles with moles, especially for larger bubbles.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated localization files.
[*]Reduced general memory usage.
[*]The Higher/Lower minigame now retains the same set of cards after reloading the campaign.
[*]Added particles to The Heat Is On stock auction.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The in-level silo tutorial now gives you the proper amount of money required to complete the tutorial. A rounding error caused you to have too little money in some scenarios, which meant you could not continue the tutorial.
[*]The single game menu now uses the entered seed when starting the level, fixing some edge cases where it would previously not use the seed.
[*]The post-campaign dialog in The Heat Is On now uses the correct localization after having played the bonus island.
[*]Resolved a UI issue related to attempting to build a pipe to the very edge of the screen in fullscreen mode.
[*]The “Tip Top” achievement is attainable again, now by reading all the tips in the Turmoil campaign instead of buying them.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "All Oil Sold" bonus was awarded even though not all oil was sold.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Magmificent achievement requirement applied to the oil well's [b]radius[/b], instead of the [b]volume[/b] as was intended. This makes the achievement easier to obtain.
[/list]

[h3]Next up: Multiplayer[/h3]
Starting next week we will be posting a weekly write-up about how the upcoming multiplayer game mode works. We hope you are as excited as we are about this, stay tuned!

notes.notes:
Hello all. Today we discovered an issue that prevented some players from logging in and thus from setting a nickname or submitting Weekly Challenge levels. This patch fixes the issue. 

If you find yourself being unable to set a nickname or submit a level, please check that you're running version 3.0.35d (seen in the bottom left of the main menu).

notes.title: Patch notes for v3.0.35
notes.notes:
Hello! Today we bring to you some bugfixes and minor additions. Thanks to everyone in the community for reporting the bugs and for suggesting improvements.

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where syncing with the cloud would cause you to lose access to the expert mode if you had not won the Heat Is On expansion campaign.
[*]You can no longer close valves while holding a wagon, silo, rig, dowser, scanner or mole.
[*]Added option to only toggle valves by holding Control, then clicking. It can be found in Settings->Game. The option is turned off by default.
[*]Starting a Challenge level right before the deadline and submitting it after the deadline no longer submits the level for the new Challenge. This caused players to be locked out from the new Challenge since they had now submitted a level for the new Challenge.
[*]Winning the campaign before the final year now awards the expert mode. Previously the expert mode would only be unlocked when playing to the end of the campaign. This applies to both classic Turmoil campaign and The Heat Is On.
[*]Improve text alignment for building names and player names. Mostly noticable in languages that use a non-default font. Thanks to Bokor for noticing this in the Hungarian version of the game.
[*]Fixed an in-level integer overflow issue related to rig spillage that would cause submitted replays to be invalidated.
[*]Fixed an issue where combining silos into a supersilo would play both the upgrade and the “Cannot afford” audio effect.
[*]The level seed is now shown in the post-level statistics screen when playing a Single Game.
[*]Having a bad connection to the game server no longer causes the game to take longer to start.
[*]Play building placement error sound when trying to build a building over another.
[*]Fixed issue where the floating heads above town buildings would not appear if you had exactly 50% stocks.
[*]When holding a scanner: the scanner price preview is now layered in front of the grass.
[/list]

That's all for now!

notes.title: Turmoil 2.0.12 - Minor patch
notes.notes:
This is a patch for a minor UI issue that allowed players to start campaigns as the wrong character, corrupting the campaign and crashing the game at the first stock auction.

[b]This patch includes the following changes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the game would remember the character you selected when in the DLC character select, then allowing you to start the game as a DLC character in the regular campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where the stock auction would crash when trying to load a non-existant image.
[/list]

Previous campaigns that were started using the Heat Is On characters will keep the wrong characters but will no longer crash when opening the stock auction.

notes.title: Update #45 - Big Things on the Horizon
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8874941/f6e483d3df9355814d972f7e153c83f846adce6b.png[/img]

[b]Dear oil entrepreneurs old and new,
[/b]

It's been a while since the last update, but this doesn't mean we that we've stopped working on the game! On the contrary, the success of Turmoil has has only enabled and inspired us to do much more. There are currently several big Turmoil things in the pipeline:

[h1]Multiplayer
[/h1]
Lots of you have asked for it, and we've always really wanted it ourselves too. To start with, we are aiming for campaigns to be playable against human opponents. These will probably be a shorter version of the original campaigns, with several changes to features like the Stock and Land Auction so that you can play against your friends and others in a turn-based fashion.

[h1]New Challenge Modes
[/h1]
The working title that we're using here is 'The Oilympics', and we've got a strong suspicion it will also be the official name. An example of a challenge could be a level in which Left and Right are closed, and then have to mine out all the oil with a limited budget. Each challenge is designed to test your skills in a specific aspect of the game and of course you will be able compete against rival drilling masters on the leaderboards.

[h1]Level Replays
[/h1]Ever wondered why you couldn't get to number one in the Weekly Challenge? With the upcoming replay system you will be able to view how other players went about their business of maximizing profits. And you can also share replays with your friends.

[h1]Mobile
[/h1]Turmoil on mobile! Turmoil is already available for iPad, but we are now also working on a version for mobile phones (you guys all have one, right? ;), and *drumroll*... Nintendo Switch. Nintendo conveniently gave the left and right Switch controllers the same color as the Left and Right Inc. buildings, so who are we to neglect such an obvious hint?

While we're happy to share this news right now, there's a difference with what we have in store and what's available in the store. It will take quite some time to get multiplayer working, we have to rebuild the game from scratch for that. So don't expect any of this in 2018. The release on Switch will probably be the first of this list, somewhere in Q1 or Q2 of 2019.

[h1]Briquid[/h1]
In the meantime! If you’d like to play another game where you have to move liquid from one place to another, you might want keep an eye on our puzzle game Briquid. It’s one of the first games we ever made, and it will now also be available on Steam,  on December 6th. You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/803280/Briquid/]here.[/url]

notes.title: Update #42 Gas improvements
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8874941/990dd20815d6dd3c62c15d1fd074d5236614b749.png[/img]

[h1]Dear oil entrepreneurs,[/h1]

After lots of hotfixes following the launch of The Heat Is On, everything’s almost oilright now. We’re still working on some trickier issues, but we’ve also found time to improve the game in other areas than just fixing bugs. The most important one changes the way in which gas is received by Left and Right Inc. Oil prices will from now on react more directly to delivered gas, and it will now also make a difference if you upgrade the pipes that transport gas to Left and Right.

We’ve also increased the arrival speed of wagons (which also caused some frustration sometimes). But the best solution to spillage is still to buy enough wagons and upgrade them! For Mac users it’s important to know that we’ve disabled the end-of-game screenshots, as that seemed to be the cause of the crashes that many players were experiencing. Note that this does not affect the flashing oil/gas wells bug.

[h1]Changelog for version 2.0.8[/h1]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Gas grown using magma heat will now fill up the existing well before increasing [*]the size of the containing well.
[*]Removed limit on amount of gas sold per second. Connecting multiple pipes to Left or Right Inc. will now make the price go up faster.
[*]Decreased gas boosting efficiency every $0.50 step from $2.50 and up.
[*]Increased gas boosting price drop rate at every $1 step from $4 and up. This drop rate only applies when you are no longer boosting. The higher you boost, the quicker it will fall again giving you less time to sell.
[*]Increased speed of oil conversion
[*]Decreased heat cost of oil conversion
[*]Increased brake speed of wagons for all upgrade levels, causing them to arrive at their goal more quickly.
[*]Decreased decision making interval of wagons from 1.13 seconds to 0.93 seconds, making them respond to full silos and overflowing rigs more quickly.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Disabled end of game screenshots for Mac OSX as it was causing segmentation and bus errors for a lot of Mac players.
Fixed that the game could crash by clicking one of the buildings during a new area introduction.
[*]Fixed that the start button on the weekly poster would flicker endlessly in some cases of losing your internet connection.
[*]Fixed that some of the hotkeys would not work during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed that bank debt did not get saved in the campaign.
[*]Fixed that the text on the play button would wrap in some languages.
[*]Fixed that you could not get any land lease payback on a piece of land when loading a campaign with a finished land auction.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #41 - The Heat Is On!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8874941/1762824ad419f36b00ccced6f56f1dae7188c0d1.png[/img]
DLC Day has arrived!

The new expansion pack: "The Heat Is On" is now live! Additionally, the Turmoil base game received some juicy updates and the option for character modding!

The update contains the following:

[h1]Expansion pack: The Heat Is On[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/804760/Turmoil__The_Heat_Is_On/
[b]New campaign, featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*]New characters to play. Greenhorns Isabelle and Kai join the oil business and could use your knowledge of pumping and drilling.
[*] A new village is being built in this area and its mayor wants you in on the spoils. Meet Maeve, Jack and Philip who will help you make the most of your land ownership.
[*] Three new areas to explore containing magma, a new way to control the oil and gas supplies in a level. Unlock its full potential by buying Jack’s upgrades in the village.
[*] A completely overhauled stock auction replacing the Dutch Auction of the original campaign. Overbid your opponents with outlandish piles of cash, or let them fight it out between each other while you bide your time.
[*] Anthony has started a treasure collection in the Underground. Dig up the treasures found in the land and he will help you out. Missed a spot? Buy the missing parts of your collection on the Treasures Marketplace.
[*] The professionals are back in the tough as nails expert version of The Heat Is On. Don’t even think about saving up money, you will be glad if you beat them by an inch!
[/list]
[b]New in-game features (Spoilers! Hover for details)[/b]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Connecting your pipes to magma will heat up your pipe network (requires Heat Conductivity upgrade, available in area 1).[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Heated pipes have increased oil flow depending on their heat level.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Dig up treasures for Anthony’s collection using moles. (requires Treasures upgrade, available in area 1)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Heating up a joint connected to a gas well will grow the gas well until it hits another well or magma (requires Gas Growth upgrade, available in area 2).[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Heating up a joint connected to an oil well will convert the oil to gas (requires Oil Conversion upgrade, available in area 3).[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Strike an exclusivity deal with either Left or Right Inc. for a small cash boost.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]And some more[/b]
[list]
[*] 9 new achievements. Can you beat them all?
[*] An all new soundtrack by Jan Jaap Doeven including three in-game songs, and a special track for the stock auction. Featuring the Return of the Son of the Dowser.
[*] The last area of the DLC campaign, Vulcanic Lands, is available as a single game level. This area includes magma and the Left/Right deals.
[*] A new main menu background.
[/list]
[h1]Changelog for version 2.0.4[/h1]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now add dialog and images for your own characters. Find out how in this guide: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1306643424 
[*] Send your creations to turmoilmods@gamious.com and we will share the best in a news post!
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] The player now has a brighter golden portrait making it easier to distinguish your character at any time.
[*] The end of game statistics have been improved with a new look to better fit the game.
[*] All character portraits have been updated with shading.
[*] Updated the credits screen with a new look.
[/list]
[b]Quality of life[/b]
[list]
[*] Your campaign will now be saved when going back to the main menu, after a land auction and after a stock auction.
[*] When playing the Weekly Challenge you get a small introduction about the area that you are playing in.
[*] You can now buy village upgrades using enter.
[*] Closing a Mayor’s Tip no longer directly exits to the village, instead it brings you back to the overview.
[*] You can now close joints before they have finished building, to make it easier to plan ahead and not spill any gas. Re-opening a joint before it is finished will refund the costs.
[*] Upgrades bought by rivals are now more clearly displayed.
[*] Improved tooltip contrast in the land auction and upgrades scroll.
[*] The village shops will now display a “sold out” text when there are no more upgrades to be bought, including future unlocks.
[*] Several localization improvements.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the minimum and increased the maximum amount of possible oil, gas and rock for the Weekly Challenge.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that sound and visual effects were not properly played when selling gas.
[*] Fixed that the game would crash if noone made a bid in the stock auction because the AI was out of money.
[/list]
Happy drilling! And stay tuned, we'll soon be back with news about a new challenge game mode!

notes.title: Update #36 - Weekly Challenge
notes.notes:
Hi all,

[h1]This update brings the Weekly Challenge to Turmoil. Every week everyone will get one chance (and one chance only!) to play the exact same level. Gamious

notes.title: Update #34 - Replay Bonus Island
notes.notes:
Hi all,

So, as promised, here is the first of two updates: Replay Bonus Island. After this we will work on a localization update and try to bring you that ASAP.

[h1]The big difference that today’s update brings is that you get control over how you play Single Levels. And that will make it more FUN! We’ve added sliders in the Area select screen that correspond with the Seed number. You will be able to determine how much Oil, Gas and Rock are in a level.[/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Early_Access_Update_34b.png[/img]

We have also added a new area: the Bonus Island! The island will have MAX Oil, Gas and Rock as that is the way it should be played. It is unlocked when you win the campaign. This brings re-playability of the Bonus Island to you for the first time! And we’re quite happy with that.

The Seed number is now a bit longer: 10 digits. This was necessary to incorporate the added custom variables. You can still copy this number and the Area and send it to a friend to have them play the exact same level.

Good luck and have fun!

[b]Changelist[/b][list]
[*]Improved Single Level game mode.[/list]

Hi all,
We’re getting into the rhythm of updating more regularly once more. Today’s update is not huge, but there are some good fixes and a nice new feature. Using your mouse wheel to send Wagons to factories for instance. You won’t have to click anymore if you so choose.

[*]Fixed Oil being drawn over snow where it should not.[/list]

notes.title: Turmoil Update #27 - Baby Steps
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Welcome to this first post release update! We'll keep counting on however, so it's update #27.

First of all: THANKS! It's been an amazing weekend. We were hoping for a good launch, but the launch exceeded our expectations and we're super happy about it. The only downside to having a massive amount of new players is having some new bugs and crashes pop up.

So, in an attempt to help everyone as quick as we can, on Monday, this Monday, we bring the first update. [b]This won't fix every bug or crash[/b]. But on short notice we're helping a lot of folks out, so hopefully it works for you.

[b]Changelist:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed 'Invalid Comparison type in gml_Object_god_other_2
[*]Fixed 'unable to find any instance for object index '29' name 'totalstats''
[*]Fixed translations not working in the Auction screens.[/list]

NOTES:
1. Vertex 
Unfortunately, the "can not create vertex buffer of size nnnnn" crash is persistent, also among other GameMaker-built games. We suspect it's related to the graphics card.

The game probably requires a dedicated graphics card for things like the ground "unveiling", the thermal effects or drawing the pipe network. We will check where we can optimize those, but this will take some time. If you are having the vertex buffer error, could you please check whether Turmoil uses a dedicated graphics card, instead of an integrated card? You can probably check this through the control panel of your graphics card. How this works is probably different per card manufacturer.
 
2. Out of Memory
Some of you also reported an "out of memory" error. We are still looking for a cause for this one. This will also take more time.

3. Mac
We were optimistic about the Mac build before launch, but we need to make sure that the people who have bought the game can actually play. So we will fix critical bugs and crashes first before taking a small rest and then starting on other things like Mac. We don't have a timeline at this moment.

notes.title: Working towards Release
notes.notes:
Hi all,
[h1]We would like to talk a little bit about what the past ten months have brought us and what we intend to do in the next two. Early Access has been great to us as a company as a whole and for Turmoil specifically. Thanks to you.[/h1]

When we brought Turmoil to Early Access it was because we needed help with a few things: input on the game, and a larger player base.

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/working-towards-release.jpg[/img]

We knew that the basis of the game; finding and digging oil, was solid. But the game as a whole lacked substance. Turmoil wasn’t far enough yet to be solid release worth $10. This was felt most notably by us when we thought we had a decent campaign going and players got to play the game and said: “That was one fun evening! Where’s the rest of the game?” We totally overestimated the content and underestimated the pace at which you consumed the game. A nice problem to have, but a problem nonetheless.

[b]Feedback[/b]
Along the way you constantly kept us informed on ideas for Turmoil. And we tried to do the same for you. We updated almost weekly. In the weeks without updates we posted our ‘In The Pipeline’ series, trying to give you a clear picture of what we were working on.

Some of your ideas, and a lot of our own, didn’t make it into the game. Multiplayer and infinite mode for instance. We tried to make it clear why features were left out. And mostly this was met with understanding. The problem with larger features like multiplayer is that we have a very small team: 1 programmer, 1 artist, 1 sound designer and 1 musician and 1 game designer helped now and then by others. [b]And everyone part-time[/b]! That makes things like multiplayer an impossibility. We did add a lot of other features that originated with your feedback: such as the Gas and Thermal dynamics, The Stock Auction (End game), AI improvements and Diamonds as well as countless other small tweaks and additions.

The problem with some of the big game design ideas from players is that very often they would require a new system to be built; adding a huge chunk of work to our already substantial workload. If we can give you a [b]Game Design Tip[/b]: try to think of new features and changes that fit in the framework that already exists. It will make it far more likely that a developer can take on your idea. Compare it to a house that is halfway through being built: If you want a new window or a change of colour, that is possible. But if you ask for 2 extra bedrooms and underground parking, when the foundation is already built, there is very little the builder can do.

[b]Community[/b]
Another big part of Early Access for us was generating a larger player base. The player based that was genereated through Early Access slowly morphed into a real community. A community that doesn’t only give input, but helps each other and had a very positive vibe. For us as a company that community transformed into more followers on social media (Twitter and Twitch especially).

We don’t have a huge [url=http://www.twitter.com/gamious]Twitter[/url] following, little over 900 now, but it’s a couple of hundreds more than we had when we started. The community is also the reason why we started streaming on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/gamiousdev]Twitch[/url]. We started off with 2-3 viewers every week. After posting the Live events in the Steam Community we went up to a peak of 50 and now we have a solid 30 viewers every week. You can imagine the other stuff that a community does for a small developer. It helps your game rise up above the large amount of smaller games trying to make it big and lays a foundation for the release of Turmoil and other games to come.

[b]Money[/b]
Along the way we also made money. Yay! We estimated Turmoil to be in Early Access for 6 months. But because it went better than expected we were able to keep developing and release a much better game after twelve months. Or at least that’s the plan. The money we earned during Early Access has gone back in development for the largest part. The other part has gone to living, eating and developing the business.

Overall Early Access has been a blessing for us. And it wouldn’t have been possible without you. We’ve gotten a large amount of useful feedback, ideas and inspiration. We were able to build up a community that was not available to us before. And we earned enough money to spend more time on developing and doing what we love: creating pure and accessible gameplay.

[b]Release[/b]
Now it’s time to get the game ready for release. We are still working on a few new features, but more and more of our time is spent on polish tasks like Steam Achievements and Trading Cards. We believe that we have created a worthwhile and fun game experience. The game’s approval rating is constantly hovering between 90-91% after 426 reviews. In about two months we will go out of Early Access and into the wild trying to build on what we created. But rest assured we also have plans for after release, in the form of free content updates.

Early Access has been very valuable to us. We value our interaction with the players enormously. hopefully you feel the same.

Thank you.
Gamious

notes.title: Early Access Update #21 - Expertly Done
notes.notes:
Hi all,

[h1]This update is quite a big one. We’ve been working on it for a while now: Expert Mode. This new campaign will add a chunk of replayability to the game. Something that you (and we) have wanted for some time. Expert Mode is essentially the same campaign but the AI is much tougher. Be prepared to lose! [/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/EAUpdate_021.jpg[/img]

To highlight that, there are 4 new characters that you will encounter in Expert Mode: Henry, Lisa, Jim Bob and Larry. Each of these characters has a nice Perk that you, the player, can play with. Expert Mode is playable from the main menu during Early Access. At release players will have to finish the normal campaign first before it unlocks.

Besides Expert Mode the Audio in Turmoil has also gotten substantially better this week. We’ve added ambient sounds for every Area. We added a dozen or so new SFX and polished a few as well. So overall the experience has really improved. We’re excited to know what you guys think about it. Here are the specifics for Update #21:

[b]New[/b][list]
[*]Expert Mode – Challenge yourself. This also introduces new playable characters with personal perks:
-Jim Bob little cousin will run ahead and mark your first oil field before you even get there.
-Larry likes to live large and takes $2500 to each plot instead of $2000
-Lisa charms her way into Barney’s life and never has to pay Spillage fines.
-Henry is a Mole's best friend. They will spot a Diamond for him without effort.[/list]

[b]And[/b][list]
[*]Audio – Ambient sound for every Area. NOTE: this is separate from SFX and Music and does NOT have it’s own volume slider YET.
[*]Audio - Lots of new Sound FX like Thermal expansion, Stock Auction counter, Drill sounds, end-game stats and more.
[*]AI – improved balance in NPC earnings after each round.
[*]Anthony – can now always be found in the Saloon at the start of Area 3 and 4. This makes him much more powerful[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b][list]
[*]Fixed the end of level screenshot not functioning properly on Fast Forward. (Thanks Asuman1179)
[*]Dowser animation now properly speeds up when Fast Forwarding.
[*]Mole animation now properly speeds up when Fast Forwarding.[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update #18 - Pipe Dream
notes.notes:
Hi all,

[h1]We have been very busy ironing out a number of issues in the game. You’ll find that this is one of our biggest updates to date. One reason for that is that we’ve had a new source of feedback from players: Twitch! We have been streaming the game on Twitch for 2 months now at http://www.twitch.tv/gamiousdev And it has been great to be in direct contact.

It helped us realize that we need to explain some things a lot better than we are doing now, like Gas. And that some systems still need work. If you want to meet us, or ask some questions, make sure to visit or Follow the channel for future broadcasts. If you are not sure how to use Gas, or if you are looking for other tips, check out our Turmoil Tips Playlist on YouTube.[/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/EAUpdate_018.jpg[/img]

The highlight for this update is that NPC’s now act more seriously. They choose proper and different upgrade paths and won’t bid on Land like headless chickens anymore. It’s a good step towards proper opponents. Pipe building has been improved upon hugely! You can now build pipes of preview (dotted) lines as a result. The Oil distribution has also been changed dramatically to make sure that bad luck is not so much the case and proper campaign progression is assured. But there is much more so read on.

Here are the specifics for Update #18:

[b]New[/b][list]
[*]Pipes – You can now build off and from Pipe Previews (dotted lines). We fixed issues with snapping, minimum pipe length and cancelling when hitting Rock.
[*]AI – The NPC’s will have proper and different Upgrade paths! They will prioritize buying specific upgrades, making them better and different opponents.
[*]AI – AI will now also find Diamonds.
[*]Oil – Distribution of Oil in an Area is now more wayward. There will also be set values in each Area to make sure every game has enough Oil. This should lessen the ‘bad luck’ and improve overall progression.
[*]Full year levels now start at level 6 (it was level 8 before).
[*]Upgrade – Point lockdown for factories. Starting in Area 3.[/list]

[b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][list]
[*]Stock auction – The bidding price of the auction will decrease more rapidly at the start and slower at the end.
[*]Moles – Searching for Gas will now be more effective.
[*]Rocks – The way Rocks are placed underground is now more erratic, less predictable.
[*]AI – Profits have been balanced for the AI players in the early game levels.
[*]AI – Bidding on land has been improved. First plot will be random. More reasonable bidding after that.
[*]Fast Forward – Fast Forward speed has been increased to 5x normal speed.
[*]Thermal – Upgrades have been balanced. Price per tier 60.000/30.000/30.000 Effect 100%/125%/156,25%
[*]Supersilo – This upgrade is now available halfway Area 3.
[*]Rig Speed – This upgrade will now be introduced in the beginning of Area 4.
[*]Updated the Upgrades players get when starting a campaign in Area 2, 3 or 4.
[*]Scanner – Tier 1 max $250 Tier 2 max $500
[*]Reviewed various texts in the game.
[*]Improved the Land Auction with Sound FX.
[*]New upgrades that become available during the game are introduced properly.
[*]Supersilo – New art for the Supersilo and a new UI icon to show that you can create a Supersilo.[/list]

[b]UI[/b][list]
[*]New Area’s now open up more smoothly and pretty. The Mayor will guide you towards your next destination.
[*]Reports – Spendings and Summary fit better in the end game reports.
[*]Pipes changed the color of the pipe line preview (dotted line).[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b][list]
[*]Fixed the pipes snapping involuntarily and building next to another pipe closer than minimum pipe length.
[*]Fixed pipes getting a Thermal glow before players acquiring the upgrade.
[*]Fixed an issue where Oil in Area 1 was too low to find.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Oil and Gas bonus wouldn’t be counted.
[*]Fixed an issue end game where old NPC’s were still hanging around Town.[/list]

notes.notes:
Hi all,

[h1]We’ve got one update left for 2015! Barring any major issues that require an immediate fix, we’ll take a break during the holidays and double our efforts in 2016 to bring the game out of Early Access and onto the bigger stage.[/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/EAUpdate_016.jpg[/img]

We’ve added a new feature: the final game mechanic in Area 4; expanding Gas. Area 4, also known as Snow, is known for a limited number of small Gas pockets. What to do?! Fred Metal has the answer: Heat them up and expand them! This will however require some effort and of course money. By laying pipes around a gas pocket and heating them up (this will also Close the pipe) a Gas pocket will grow until it hits the pipe. Giving you the much needed Gas to get those prices up.

notes.title: Early Access Update #14 - Stock it to the man!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We’ve got a substantial update for you! So hang on to your hats and read on.

[h1]Stocks, our new game system, is in place. You will now get the chance to buy Stocks in town and become the next mayor! Every level will be followed by a tense bidding war for a few % of the Stocks. To win the game you need 51% of all the Stocks. This means you will need to make more choices after every level: Upgrades or Stocks or Both?! Note: it’s all coder art right now, our Artist is working on a visual upgrade.[/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/EAUpdate_015.jpg[/img]

On top of that there is also a brand new World Map! Besides adding a riverboat instead of a pirate ship. The Desert now serves as Area 2. We made Area 1 a bit smaller, speeding up the early game into Rock by a couple of levels. There’s also an island in the middle, but you’ll need to find what that is for yourselves…

Lots of other smaller changes in this build, as listed below, but be assured that this is one of the biggest updates that we have done in a while. We hope you enjoy is and we await your feedback in the forums. Because of the Campaign changes a Save Game Reset was inevitable!

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SaveGameReset.png[/img]

Just to finish up: on Thursday (5 pm CET) we play Turmoil, LIVE on Twitch at http://www.twitch.tv/gamiousdev So if you want to meet us, or ask some questions, make sure to visit or Follow the channel for future broadcasts.

Here are the specifics for Update #15:

[b]New[/b][list]
[*]Stocks – a bidding war to become the mayor of our Town. This starts half way in Area 2.
[*]World Map – completely revised. Area 1 is smaller, Area 2 is now the desert, Plains is Area 3. We’ve also added a mysterious island.
[*]Bank loans – Loans in Town can now be adjusted up and down before taking them.
[*]Herd Size – Upgrades are available from the start.
[*]Spillage – Fines now increase every Area: Area 1 = x1, Area 2 = x2, Area 3 = x4, Area 4 = x8.
[*]Barney – Offers will increase Area: Area 1 = x1, Area 2 = x2, Area 3 = x4, Area 4 = x8.
[*]End game report – Profits are now auto-highlighted in the Graphs tab.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b][list]
[*]New texts and windows for the end game and Stocks.
[*]Pipe preview is now a dotted line while under your cursor as well.
[*]Various text fixes
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b][list]
[*]Fixed various small issues with the new UI. Thanks for the reports! We’re not done yet, Stocks took up a lot of time.
[*]Fixed various bugs and crashes.
[*]Fixed an issue where the HUD worked incorrectly after skipping the tutorial.

notes.title: Early Access Update #7 – A Fix in the mix
notes.notes:
[h1][b]SORRY![/b] That’s what we are going with today. Last week, just before we headed out to gamescom, we pushed out a minor update that caused major issues to a few players. And we weren’t around to clean up the mess![/h1]

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/EAUpdate_007a.png[/img]

We will skip our usual “In the Pipeline” announcement this week in order to bring you this update as fast as possible. The update is dedicated to fixing most of the issues that were created with the last one. While we can’t guarantee that the fixes will work on every system known to man, we do know that a lot of the issues have been resolved. We’ll list the resolutions below.

[h1]Thanks for your patience and understanding![/h1]

On top of the game breaking fixes we were working on our next batch of new features, so we chose to include what we had today as well. There is now a Super Silo! Yes. Seriously. You can combine 2 Silos that are fully upgraded to create this beast!

The mole has new upgrades and we’ve introduced Wagon herd size (maximum amount of Wagons that you can run). More than enough to keep you busy for a while.

NOTE:
We haven’t had time yet to address the new wagon AI. We could do that, but it would push these fixes back without a guarantee of better AI. So we will keep working on that and improve on it when we can. 

Here are the specifics for Update #7:

[b]Crashes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a crash when starting a campaign without a character selected. Selecting a character is now mandatory.
[*]Fixed a crash with Shaders on most systems. IF this still happens you can also choose to turn the Shader OFF in the Settings menu.
[*]Fixed a crash when going to the Report screen in the Bank in town.
[*]Fixed a crash when going to the bidding screen (not seen very often).
[/list]
[b]New[/b][list]
[*]Super Silos – Combine 2 Silos that have been fully upgraded. This enhances the oil storage capacity. The two silos need to be adjacent to each other.
[*]Super Silo upgrade added to the Factory.
[*]Mole gas upgrade – the mole will scan for gas near his first tile.
[*]Mole speed upgrade – faster moles!
[*]Mole Tile amount upgrade – more tiles opened up by the mole. To the amount of 6/9/12
[*]Wagon Herd upgrade – max wagon amount can be increased. To the amount of 15/25/40.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b][list]
[*]Header ‘Upgrades’ removed from Factory, Workshop and Stable.
[*]When an upgrade hub has more than 4 upgrade the UI scales to show more.
[*]Show the amount of diamonds for the entire campaign.
[*]Added Tutorial texts for the new upgrades.
[*]Report – Gas influence on the price fluctuation is now accounted for in the Graphs.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b][list]
[*]Pitch variation in Rig sounds when bringing oil up.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access update #5 - New Rig, Buttons and Natural Gas
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/Early_Access_Update5.png[/img]

Our fifth update is a radical one! Starting from area 3 (Desert), the way you play Turmoil will change a lot. Next to patches of oil, you will also be able to hit patches filled with natural gas. This addition has all sorts of implications for the Campaign mode, with new upgrades and changed earning dynamics, that a save game reset was inevitable.

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SaveGameReset.png[/img]

We hope this will not be too cruel for you. While building this Early Access-game, it's an impopular decision we sometimes have to take, for the good of the game. User feedback is essential to find out if we got things like balancing right. So we can't stress enough how happy we are with the active Turmoil community!

We tried to make the save game reset less cruel however. To avoid players from having to start all over from the beginning, we added the option to start at later areas, with a healthy amount of upgrades and cash. If you're diving straight into the levels with natural gas, it might be handy to check out this announcement which gives you a bit of and explanation (which the game lacks a bit right now).

Next to the addition of natural gas, quite a few other things have been added/improved as well. The most noticable of these is the new appearance of the in-level buttons above the rigs, silos and factories. Another nice improvement is the new rig. It has a bit more detail, and the wheels of the rigs are more prominently visible. Here's the entire list:

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]Higher ground levels at start of levels, earlier maximum height reached
[*]New upgrades: Rig Lockdown, Rig Timer, Left/Right Gas Links
[*]Natural gas (boosts oil price, boosts oil pressure)
[*]Message for Korean players in the title screen (apologizing for lack of [*]Korean localization and save game resets)
[*]Save game erase message
[*]Price changes (most things are more expensive now)
[*]In-level intrest is higher, and also raises per $500 loan
[*]Choose of begin area in Single Game and Campaign mode
[*]New bonus: all gas depleted
[*]Better visualization of oil flow through pipes
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]New buttons for silo, rig and Left/Right.
[*]New rig button: Lockdown
[*]Hud calendar and prizes not clickable anymore (to prevent overlapping issues)
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorial deathlocks resolved
[*]'New in this version' crash resolved
[*]And lots of other tiny bugs, splatted!

notes.title: Early Access Update #3 – Hotkeys and Pie Charts
notes.notes:
The third update in Turmoils Early Access life is called Hotkeys and Pie Charts. Quite a boring title, as it should have been called: the-update-that-makes-playing-Turmoil-much-easier-and-much-more-freaking-fun! But that just didn’t sound quite right.

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/EAUpdate_003.png[/img]

The biggest changes improve usability in a huge way: hotkeys and post-game reporting. Hotkeys speak for themselves. From now on players will be able to place buildings, wagons and search tools. With a tap of the finger and a subtle click, you will play turmoil with much more ease than before. More details below, but we’ll spoil one for you here: press and hold the arrows above and below the Inc’s to quickly assign lots of wagons.

Secondly reporting. We’ve had detailed reporting in the game since forever. But now the reporting is more polished than ever and enhanced quite a bit. After the each game you will find the Graphs, your Earning, Spendings and an end of game Screenshot. Please note that the Earnings also include an average sell price per Inc. And the Spendings are neatly organized in a Pie Chart! We have a bloody Pie Chart in our game now. How cool is that?! Here's a quick preview:

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/Reporting.png[/img]

And here are the specifics for Update #3

[b]Hotkeys[/b]
Hotkeys have been added to the game! Here is the exact list:[list]
[*]1 or C – Scanner
[*]2 or D – Dowser
[*]3 or M – Mole
[*]4 or R – Rig
[*]5 or S – Silo
[*]6 or W – Wagon
[*]F - Finances
[*]Press and Hold mouse on an arrow to quickly assign Wagons to Inc’s.
[*]Use Right Mouse button to cancel any build item on your cursor.
[/list]
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]Post-game reporting is now cleaner, nicer and has a Pie Chart. Use the arrows to move through the Graphs, Earnings, Spendings and Screenshot.
[*]New backgrounds in the Plains and River Country in the campaign.
[*]You can now sell Diamonds in the Bank.
[*]Borrowing money in town gets progressively more expensive.
[*]Rig speed update has been pushed back a bit.
[*]Dowser depth is now visualized.
[*]Added a ‘negative’ audio effect when trying to upgrade a pipe that you can not upgrade.[/list]
[b]UI[/b][list]
[*]Bank now has the same layout as the rest of the town showing Loan, Report and Diamonds.
[*]Mole icon will change after upgrade has been bought in town.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b][list]
[*]Rig wheels now scale up correctly.
[*]Rig speed upgrade will not affect speed through Rocks anymore. Rocks are hard!
[*]The smoke at Left and Right Inc. Now actually comes out of the chimney instead of an imaginary position somewhere in the air.[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update #2 – Between Rock and a hard place
notes.notes:
Our second update is devoted to smoothing out the campaign. 

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/Patch_EA2_header.png[/img]

The first area downsized and we dug up all the rock in that area and moved it over to the other areas. So NO rock in area 1 anymore!  This change means that the old save games are no longer valid and you will have to start a new campaign.

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SaveGameReset.png[/img]

We did however put something back in the ground to soften the blow: [b]Diamonds[/b]! You can now find and collect diamonds underground, BUT you will need the mole to do it! So upgrade  the mole and use it to get those diamonds out of the ground and into your pocket.

We had some trouble with a bug that caused the game to freeze entirely, therefore we didn’t update on Friday as we had hoped. You guys also ran into a bug at the very end of the game (very time consuming to reproduce I might add!) and we tried to fix that as well but of course stuff will still break occasionally. So we didn’t get to do all we wanted, but we did a lot. The next update will probably be of a more visual nature and should happen at the end of next week. We’ll keep you posted in our next ‘In the Pipeline’ post. Now go ahead and read the entire list:

[b]New[/b][list]

[*]Diamonds – added as an underground find, starting in Area 2. You can get these shinies out of the ground with a Mole, but you’ll need a Mole upgrade to do so. You can NOT drill through Diamonds. Diamonds are sell-able in the Saloon at variable prices.
[*]Rock – Rock has been removed from area 1 and starts in area 2 now. The drill upgrade has also been moved back until area 2.
[*]Scanning – The Scan tutorial has been improved. The functionality has also changed in order to teach players that the Scanner can grow!
[*]The amount of oil in area 1 has been normalized making sure everyone gets roughly the same start to the game.
[*]Report – Post game reports have been added at the end of a game and have been upgraded. You can now also click on stats that you want to see. Daily stats have been removed.
[*]Map - Display on the map which plots had a diamond in them.
[*]Upgrade - Drill Speed upgrade has been added to the game. There are 3 speeds: 100% (default), upgrade 1: 175% and upgrade 2: 300% of default speed. The Drill speed upgrades can be found in the Factory.
[*]Icons - New size and speed upgrades for wagons.
[*]Icons - New icons for Diamonds (in town and in-game) and the Mole (Diamond upgrade).
[/list]
[b]UI[/b][list]

[*]Show the amount of diamonds a player has.
[*]Added new text for Diamonds and the Mole upgrade.
[*]Added new text for Rock drill upgrade.
[*]Added a speed upgrade button to the Rig (Can overlap with the Rock upgrade button of a different Rig).
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b][list]

[*]Fixed bug where the scanner would freeze the game.
[*]Seeds that should have been identical were not – Fixed.
[*]Overlapping text UI is now properly layered.
[*]Not displaying “Land lease ends on *date* anymore when there is no calendar yet.
[*]Not displaying mouse-overs for invisible UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update #1 - Wagons out of Control
notes.notes:
Here it is! Our first post release update, [b]Early Access Update #1[/b] We are up to build version 160 now. That should give you a rough idea of how many things have been created, altered, introduced, scrapped, fixed and enhanced over the last year or more. This is actually the second update on Steam, the first one was [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/361280/announcements/detail/196251273316116980]pre-release[/url].

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/Patch_2_header-v2.png[/img]

This first update focusses on the very first interactions that our brand new players had with the game. And it was quite clear that we had to address the wagons. Or, to be more exact, the wagoneers who are driving the carts! They had no problems carrying half full carts of Silo-oil to a factory, while a Rig might be overflowing on top of them. We have adjusted their behaviour, but we expect that it’s not perfect yet. So please keep playing and keep giving feedback.

Since launch lots of people played a lot of Turmoil games. And, not surprisingly, for a few of them the game fell flat on its face. There are pacing issues in the beginning of the game and, if you are unlucky, in area 1 as a whole. Oil fill in levels is randomized, but there is a correlation between adjacent plots of lands to make the bidding war on the area map interesting; you can deduct the amount of oil inside a plot from the plots around it. But if the starting point was very low (very red number), the entire area would be very low because of it. This leads to a slow campaign with not enough money for upgrades. The opposite is also true, making players filthy rich, but no one complained about having too much money for some reason.

There is a lot more, but as not many people read this far, I might as well go straight into the list.

Enjoy!

[b]Changes[/b][list]

[*][b]Changed behaviour of the wagons picking up oil for factories. Test and report![/b]
[*][b]Withdrawing the land lease (quitting a level) is no explained better and you can ‘quit now’ if you don’t want to wait until the end of the month.[/b]
[*]Withdraw land lease will only be possible in levels that last 1 year and only after July 1st
[*]Save games can be carried over to the next version of the game! That's a first for Turmoil.
[*]Pause button now has Settings and Back to menu.
[*]Added a skip Tutorial button – Note this skips level 1 only as, starting from level 2, you are already earning money towards your campaign. Rewiring the campaign to make sure that doesn’t happen would have taken too much time to fit in this update.
[*]The game will start fullscreen now.
[*]End game (after finishing all plots of land in all areas) - added a screen with explanation, made sure you can still access the town afterwards and a new map without bidding mechanisms opens up.
[*]Upgrading the wagons will now actually increase the visual size of the wagons.
[*]Added volume sliders for Music and SFC in the Settings menu.
[*]New Left and Right Inc. visuals.
[*]Added a changelog in the splashscreen with a link to Steam.
[*]New character art.
[*]Added $1000 bonus when withdrawing the land lease before December 1st
[*]Lowered Rig upgrade price to $750.
[*]Level 1 will stop when reaching 1300. Was 1350 before. This will save one trip!
[*]Horse counter upgrade is now $2500.
[*]Changed values of Saloon bribes.
[*]When hitting rock, more pieces of land will be unveiled to give a player more info about the rock.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the Report button to the end-game summary.
[*]New arrows for above and below the factories.
[*]Added wagon upgrade price tag.
[*]Re-aligned price tags.
[*]Resized Pause button, Rig and Silo upgrade buttons.

notes.title: Early Access Update #1 - Wagons out of Control
notes.notes:
Here it is! Our first post release update, [b]Early Access Update #1[/b] We are up to build version 160 now. That should give you a rough idea of how many things have been created, altered, introduced, scrapped, fixed and enhanced over the last year or more. This is actually the second update on Steam, the first one was [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/361280/announcements/detail/196251273316116980]pre-release[/url].

[img]http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/Patch_2_header-v2.png[/img]

This first update focusses on the very first interactions that our brand new players had with the game. And it was quite clear that we had to address the wagons. Or, to be more exact, the wagoneers who are driving the carts! They had no problems carrying half full carts of Silo-oil to a factory, while a Rig might be overflowing on top of them. We have adjusted their behaviour, but we expect that it’s not perfect yet. So please keep playing and keep giving feedback.

Since launch lots of people played a lot of Turmoil games. And, not surprisingly, for a few of them the game fell flat on its face. There are pacing issues in the beginning of the game and, if you are unlucky, in area 1 as a whole. Oil fill in levels is randomized, but there is a correlation between adjacent plots of lands to make the bidding war on the area map interesting; you can deduct the amount of oil inside a plot from the plots around it. But if the starting point was very low (very red number), the entire area would be very low because of it. This leads to a slow campaign with not enough money for upgrades. The opposite is also true, making players filthy rich, but no one complained about having too much money for some reason.

There is a lot more, but as not many people read this far, I might as well go straight into the list.

Enjoy!

[*][b]Changed behaviour of the wagons picking up oil for factories. Test and report![/b]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.0.0.156
notes.notes:
[b]We wanted to fix a couple of things before we released on Early Access. Some changes were necessary to keep the game from breaking, others were needed to improve the first time experience for new players and even more fixes were made just for our peace of mind and enjoyment.[/b]

[img] http://www.gamious.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/Update_156.png [/img]

A prominent change was the addition of Blanche, our second female playable character. We wanted to feature another strong woman in the game. That sadly meant that Barney had to go! Barney was not happy, of course, but we gave him a different job to do.

Another big change was an alteration in the Spillage fine system. We want spillages to matter as we need to keep the beautiful countryside clean of harmful oil. Or as Ricardo would say: “Spilling oil is like not asking a pretty lady to dance with you!”. Whatever. Minimum spillages fines have been reduced in the levels with a shorter time frame.

A major bug fix made sure that game does not come to a grinding halt at the end of area 1. This automatically opens up Area’s 2,3 and 4, and therefore guarantees an extra 7,5 hours of gameplay at the very least. Who knew that 4 players required an amount of plots dividable by 4?! We sure didn’t!

Our first list of patch notes on Steam. Enjoy!

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*]A second female playable character (Blanche) has replaced Barney.
[*]Barney is now the environmental watch dog. You will meet him in the Saloon.[*]We changed the minimum fine amount for Spillage. It now relates to the length of the level: shorter levels mean lower spillage fines. 3 months $250, 6 months $500 and 12 months $1000.
[*]The dowser has new animations and will not stand idly by when searching for oil.
[*]Audio volume of opening doors has been upped.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b][list]
[*]Added mouse-over info for upgrading pipes indicating the cost.
[*]Added mouse-over info for the calendar indicating the end date of the level.
[*]Added cost info for horse and carriage upgrades.
[*]Added mouse-over info on the auction screen indicating “Open for Bids” on available land.
[*]Added the ‘Report’ button the bank pop up.
[*]Added a message about Early Access after finishing area 1.
[*]Cash counter now is highlighted when William tells you about lending money.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b][list]
[*]We fixed the map for area 1 so that all players can get a piece of land at the end. This was a game breaking bug. We also prepared the next areas so that the same doesn’t happen there.
[*]Fixed “Land not available yet” mouse-over text, on the auction screen, that would appear underneath other UI.
[*]Fixed Pause text appearing underneath other UI.
[*]When hitting rock underground for the first time, Fred would show up but not say anything. 
[*]When entering the stage, Raynor now enters through the open door and not the side of the stage!
[*]Various text improvements. Mostly explaining important info properly.
[*]Fixed a bug in the tutorial section where it was possible to not have enough money to buy your first Silo.
[/list]
